desktop.notes:
• Albums have their own place: an ALBUMS section in the left sidebar (like Lightroom's Collections) - each album with its cover, name and count. Click = only that album, with an "Album: … ✕ Show all photos" bar on top; drag photos onto an album to add them; right-click = rename, note, target album, Send to Library, copy, delete (photos stay); + = new album from the selection.
• Target album ◎ + Ctrl+B adds the selected photos (or takes them out again).
• Albums card in the right panel (album names, ✕ to take out, + Add to album…) and a small album badge on thumbnails. Albums no longer show as a tag chip / in the tags.
• Drag photos out of the grid / filmstrip into Explorer or a chat: copies of their JPEGs (never moved).
• Albums made or changed in Studio come back to Cullect from the Library (newest change wins).
